traits.name: Battle-Hardened
traits.description: The lieutenant reduces all damage they take by 2 (minimum 1) and is immune to the Surprised condition.

traits.name: Coordinated Ambush
traits.description: Allies within 30 feet of the lieutenant who can hear them gain advantage on their Stealth tests when using the Ambusher trait.

actions.name: Cover!
actions.description: When an enemy targets an ally within 30 feet who can hear the lieutenant with an attack, the lieutenant shouts a warning. That ally can immediately move up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks before the attack resolves.

actions.name: Suppressing Volley
actions.description: The lieutenant fires rapidly across a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Agility test or take 10 (3d6) keen damage and become Immobilized until the start of the lieutenant's next turn. On a success, they take half damage only.

actions.name: Break and Run
actions.description: Once per scene, immediately after the lieutenant hits with an attack, they signal a tactical withdrawal. All allies within 30 feet who can hear the lieutenant can immediately use the Move and Disengage actions as free reactions.

strikes.name: Military Sabre
strikes.description: Attack +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 4 (1d8) keen damage. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) keen damage.

strikes.name: Composite Bow
strikes.description: Attack +6, range 80/320 ft., one target. Graze: 4 (1d8) keen damage. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) keen damage.
